floor_layers._pick: Cemetery-floor variation reusing the dungeon biome's own verified floor-tile neighborhood (2,2)/(3,7) plus the genuinely darker worn variant (2,11) for real wear texture.

entities._comment: Return leg of the new dungeon_approach<->trapped_halls door pair.

entities.observe: One flagstone sits a hair proud of its neighbors, the mortar cracked clean around its edge. Stepping square on it feels like a very bad idea.
entities.toast: The flagstone gives half an inch under your hand. Somewhere close, something CLICKS. Nothing else happens. This time.

entities._comment: Own graph (ksmvr_plates.json): the guide option is the real beat, gated on `horns_party_formed` (the party must exist to guide)
entities._comment_dig: 2026-07-27 Task 2.7 round 2 (controller-sanctioned): retires PERMANENTLY at horns_dig_joined. The delve-staging Horns had no present_when at all, so once round 1 fixed the inn-vs-camp bilocation the SAME bug relocated here -- during The Dig a player could meet camp-Ceria at the ruin and delve-hub-Ceria on the approach in one trip. No `_returned` twin on the delve maps, deliberately: the Horns moved on from the delve staging for good (the_horns_home already has them living at the inn; the dig and then the mounting is what brings them there). Safe for the seal beat -- this row is only gameplay-load-bearing during what_the_seal_kept, and seal_kept_reported gates the dig invitation, so horns_dig_joined cannot bank until that quest is done. Verified at QA level too: every script touching this map (delve_fight, delve_skill, delve_talk, dungeon_peek, dungeon_kingslayer_loop) runs on a fixture with horns_dig_joined absent, so no entity-count pin moves.

entities.skill_hint_toast: A narrow slit runs along the wall at knee height, primed and waiting. This wants a careful, deliberate touch, not a shove.
entities.locked_toast: A narrow slit runs along the wall at knee height. Whatever is loaded behind it, you have no idea how to disable it.
entities.item_hint_toast: A narrow slit runs along the wall at knee height, primed and waiting. Bare hands won't do it -- you'd want a proper kit for this.

on_skill_use.toast: You trace the mechanism with a careful eye, find the catch, and wedge it still with a wax-and-wire pick from the kit. The slit stays dark.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The floor ahead looks exactly like the floor behind you. Somehow, that is the part that bothers you.
entities.locked_toast: The floor ahead looks perfectly ordinary. Something about it still itches at the back of your mind.

on_skill_use.toast: You look again, and this time you see it: the grain runs the wrong way, and no dust has settled in months. That is not floor. That is a very good painting of floor.

entities.skill_hint_toast: Something under the stone hums off-key. Eyes that read mana could say what.
entities.locked_toast: The stone here looks like all the other stone. It is not.

on_skill_use.toast: [Detect Magic] — The seam lights up like a badly kept secret: old wardwork, still holding, drawn tight around the floor ahead. Now you know exactly what not to trust.

entities.observe: A coil of taut wire lies strung ankle-height between two stones, near-invisible against the dust. Whatever it is rigged to is worse than a stubbed toe.
entities.gate_closed_toast: You give the wire a wide berth. Something in the dark past it has not noticed you yet.

entities._comment: Matches rift_vermin_leak/ruin_guardian/awakened_boss's own interact-only convention for a boss the player consciously commits to, not an environmental ambush.
entities.observe: The hall ends in a sealed archway, and beyond it something vast fills the dark almost completely -- the same shape you glimpsed crouched near the entrance, closer now, utterly still. It is not still the way a statue is still.
entities.gate_closed_toast: Whatever waits beyond this arch, you are not walking into it yet — not with the halls still armed, not without the Horns at your back.

entities._comment: 2026-07-26 main-quest spec 7 amendment 1: display name was 'A Second Door'. The entity id is shipped and frozen; the fiction is not. This is a sealed rune-door full of wardwork by the hand that cut the inn's frame -- never a second Magical Door, never another portal. No QA script pins the old label (checked qa/scripts + qa/manifest).
entities.toast: The passage doesn't end here -- it just goes quiet, past a bend the light doesn't reach. Whatever's back there, this isn't the moment.

variants.toast: The runes are the same. Not similar — the same hand, the same order, as the door in the inn's pantry.

entities._comment: respawns:true (dormant until the next sleep, the rock_crab_nest/kingslayer_den mechanism).
entities.gate_closed_toast: Rubble and old wardwork still choke this side passage. Whatever's back there can wait until the main halls are actually safe.
entities.observe: A narrower passage breaks off from the gauntlet proper, half-choked with fallen stone. Small shapes move in the dark past the rubble -- more than one.

companion_source.taken_toast: The bones rise and fall into step behind you.

entities.observe: Old bones, settled where they fell. They are not going anywhere. Probably.
